label: Mapped Item

description: Purchase Invoice Automation will never write to this Supplier's Tax Withholding Category, keeping ERPNext's automatic TDS permanently off for it. Use this for suppliers whose invoices never cross ERPNext's own TDS threshold but should still have TDS deducted manually on every invoice (e.g. OVH).
label: Exclude from Automatic TDS
name: Supplier-exclude_from_auto_tds
